_about: Design tokens for the TTS clone. Roles measured from the original's public pages on 2026-11-21 (replica/screens/). Neutrals keep the measured system. The accent is a neutral placeholder until /replica-brand. Check every change with: python3 .claude/skills/replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json

_measured.surface: white cards, with a white to rgb(248,250,252) wash
_measured.text-muted: rgb(107,114,128), 90 text nodes, the most common text colour
_measured.ink-button: rgb(0,0,0) and rgb(17,24,39) pill buttons with white text
_measured.accent: the original uses a blue-indigo-purple-pink gradient on the hero heading. That is its signature. Recorded as a role only, not copied
_measured.badge: coral gradient on the premium badge. Recorded as a role only
_measured.border-input: the original's track and input grey fails 3:1 on white. Darkened here on purpose

font.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif
font._note: The original uses Tajawal, a free Google font. IBM Plex Sans Arabic does the same job, is open (OFL) and keeps the clone visually distinct. Both are allowed.

type._note: Measured sizes were 11.5 to 19.2px in odd rem steps, a 32px section heading and a 64px hero. Snapped to this scale. Arabic needs taller line heights than Latin, about 1.6 for body.

_space_note: Measured: 12, 6, 24, 16, 10, 8, 32, 40, 80 were the common gaps. A 4px base with 2 for hairlines.
_radius_note: Measured: 24px cards (87 uses), pill buttons and nav, 10px small parts, 50% avatars.

layout._note: Measured: content capped at 1000px, voice cards 312x158 in a 3-column grid, nav pill 46px centred in the header.

size._note: Fixed component sizes from components.md. Used as h-*, w-*, size-* in Tailwind.
